*New Community Brings Quality Home Designs to an Ideal Barrow County Location*


WINDER, Ga.


, Sept. 2, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Lennar, one of the nation's leading homebuilders, today announced the Grand Opening of Lake Shore, a new community of single-family homes in Winder, Georgia. Lake Shore offers spacious and flexible home designs at attainable price points, onsite amenities including a pool and pool house, and a desirable commuter location between Athens and Atlanta near the University of Georgia. Interested homebuyers are invited to the Grand Opening celebration on September 12 at 11:00 a.m. to explore the thoughtfully designed floorplans and experience the peaceful yet connected lifestyle the community will offer.


"Lake Shore brings affordable, well-designed homes to a growing corner of Barrow County, within walking distance of Winder Elementary School and close to popular local shopping, dining and outdoor recreation," said Scott Withington, Division President of Lennar's Atlanta Division. "We're proud to welcome our first homeowners to a community built with the needs of local homebuyers in mind."


Lake Shore features three exclusive Lennar home designs: Hampton, Roswell and Portland. Homes range from 2,176 to 2,984 square feet with four to six bedrooms and two-and-a-half to four bathrooms. Open-concept home designs anchor every floorplan, with several homes offering first-floor suites, downstairs flexible spaces and upstairs lofts, giving families room to grow. Pricing starts in the mid-$400,000s.


Every home at Lake Shore comes with Lennar's[Everything's Included®](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4765939-1&h=2577040992&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4757512-1%26h%3D1640537382%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fedge.prnewswire.com%252Fc%252Flink%252F%253Ft%253D0%2526l%253Den%2526o%253D4727920-1%2526h%253D1244429014%2526u%253Dhttps%25253A%25252F%25252Fedge.prnewswire.com%25252Fc%25252Flink%25252F%25253Ft%25253D0%252526l%25253Den%252526o%25253D4634251-1%252526h%25253D1763803708%252526u%25253Dhttps%2525253A%2525252F%2525252Fc212.net%2525252Fc%2525252Flink%2525252F%2525253Ft%2525253D0%25252526l%2525253Den%25252526o%2525253D4083698-1%25252526h%2525253D1485268572%25252526u%2525253Dhttps%252525253A%252525252F%252525252Fwww.lennar.com%252525252Fproductsandservices%252525252Feverythings-included%25252526a%2525253DEverything%2525252527s%2525252BIncluded%25252525C2%25252525AE%252526a%25253DEverything%25252527s%25252BIncluded%252525C2%252525AE%2526a%253DEverything%252527s%252BIncluded%2525C2%2525AE%26a%3DEverything%2527s%2BIncluded%25C2%25AE&a=Everything%27s+Included%C2%AE) promise, where popular features and finishes come standard and included in the base price of the home. For Lake Shore homes, this includes smart home features like Honeywell Home ElitePro Thermostats, a Wi-Fi garage door opener and a smart door lock.


Lake Shore homeowners can take advantage of community amenities including a pool, pool house and scenic walking trails, along with quick access to the outdoor recreation nearby Fort Yargo State Park has to offer. Located near downtown Winder and Barrow Crossing Shopping Center, residents can also enjoy quick connectivity to ample local shopping, dining, and community events. Lake Shore is served by Winder Elementary School, Russell Middle School and Winder-Barrow High School, making the community's access to top-rated schools an ideal place to live for families.


For more information on Lake Shore, call (470) 945-9165 or visit the[community website](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4765939-1&h=2379204842&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lennar.com%2Fnew-homes%2Fgeorgia%2Fatlanta%2Fwinder%2Flake-shore%23about&a=community+website) .


**About Lennar Corporation**
Lennar Corporation, founded in 1954, is one of the nation's leading builders of quality homes for all generations. Lennar builds affordable, move-up and active adult homes primarily under the Lennar brand name. Lennar's Financial Services segment provides mortgage financing, title and closing services primarily for buyers of Lennar's homes and, through LMF Commercial, originates mortgage loans secured primarily by commercial real estate properties throughout the United States. Lennar's Multifamily segment is a nationwide developer of high-quality multifamily rental properties. LENX drives Lennar's technology, innovation and strategic investments. For more information about Lennar, please visit **[www.lennar.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4765939-1&h=4102051212&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lennar.com%2F&a=www.lennar.com)** .
